tables.title: What do they think you are?

entries.text: Someone who reminds them of themselves

tables.title: What changed between us?
tables.note: Also: Why are they disappointed in me? Why am I disappointed in them?

entries.text: I wasn’t there when they needed me
I kept something important from them
They don’t trust my judgment anymore
They changed and I don’t like it
I failed to live up to what they thought I was
They treated me like a child
I treated them like they couldn’t handle the truth
One of us made the relationship public
One of us made the relationship conditional

tables.title: What do they need from me?
tables.note: Also: What expectation are they placing on me? What would repair this relationship?

entries.text: For me to admit they were right
For me to stop protecting them
For me to become who they think I can be

tables.title: What are they not telling me?

entries.text: They’ve made a decision without me
They know something about my powers
They know something about my family
They’re being pressured by someone else
They think I don’t trust them
We remember the same event differently

tables.title: Interlude Scene
tables.source: Sundered Isles, Shawn Tomkin, p. 228; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Masks substitutions by Doyce Testerman
tables.note: A scene prompt; interpret using Masks fiction and moves.

entries.questions: What goes into your journal, messages, or posts? What do you leave out?
What flora or fauna do you encounter? What inspiration do you draw from the experience?
What new strategy do you devise? How will you put this plan in motion?
What is the nature of the research? What information or insight do you gain?
What skill or power do you practice? Who accepts guidance, and who resists it?
What do you reveal of your nature or background? How do others respond?
What is the subject of this reminiscence? Why is it meaningful in this moment?
What do you create? What is it intended for?
What is the nature of the dream or vision? What meaning do you draw from it?
Who do you spar with? What issues do you provoke or resolve during the match?
How do you reflect, meditate, or pray? What enlightenment do you gain?
Who shares an aspect of their nature or background? What do they reveal?
What weakness or need do you indulge? How is this viewed by others?
What is the occasion of this social gathering? How do you participate?
What do you play, sing, or listen to together? Why does it matter?
Why is this motivation needed, and what is your approach? How do they respond?
Who do you play with? What is discussed during the game?
What talent do you hone? What do you learn from the exercise?
What do you repair, modify, or prepare? What are you expecting?
Who is the message meant for? What news or feelings do you share?
What inspires the change? Is it your civilian appearance, heroic identity, or both?
What caused this argument or fight? How do you resolve the situation?
Who do you spend time with? How does your relationship evolve?
What do you reveal about your family, culture, or heroic legacy? What memory or regret comes with it?
What are you on the lookout for? What do you spot or overhear?
What conflict do you incite or inflame? Why is the situation left unresolved?
What sublime or dramatic scenery do you witness? What emotion or memory does it inspire?
Whose story do you tell? What feeling or lesson lingers afterward?
What project brings you together? What happens between you while you work?
What ordinary responsibility needs doing? What occupies your thoughts?

tables.title: Story Complication

tables.note: A scene prompt; interpret using Masks fiction and moves.

entries.text: Crucial gear, technology, or support fails
Crucial gear, technology, or support is sabotaged
Enemy reveals unexpected powers, abilities, or influence
Enemy reveals their true agenda or nature
Enemy unexpectedly benefits from your actions
Key location is threatened or made unsafe
Needed equipment, information, or help is unavailable
The objective isn’t what you assumed
Simultaneous problems force a hard choice
Someone important is threatened or endangered
Someone important reveals their problematic secret or history
Gear, technology, or a power has unexpected effects
The true agenda of an ally, mentor, or authority figure is revealed
Trusted information is shown to be false
Two seemingly unrelated problems are shown to be connected
An urgent message pulls you away from what you’re doing
You were diverted from the true crisis

entries.text: Affirms a previously understood fact or clue

Connects to a previously unrelated mystery or problem
Connects to your own expertise or interests
Contradicts a previously understood fact or clue
Evokes a remarkable anomaly or phenomenon
Involves a hidden or mysterious organization
Involves a hidden or mysterious person
Involves a key or means of access
Involves a non-human being or creature
Involves a person or organization from your background
Involves an organism or biological evidence
Involves an unusual ability or power
Involves something rare, expensive, or precious
Leads to a distant or unfamiliar place
Leads to a hidden or forgotten place
Leads to a nearby or familiar place
Leads to a notable or central place
Suggests a history of similar incidents
Suggests a looming event or deadline

entries.text: Block a path or cut off an objective
Destroy something or render it useless
Force off balance or out of position
Exploit the advantage of a power, weapon, or ability
Make a cautious or probing attack
Make a ferocious or reckless attack
Make a precise or careful attack
Make a showy move intended to impress
Reveal an unexpected ability or weapon
Shift the fight to a new area
Use a power, weapon, or ability in an unexpected way
